runtime.name: Astral python-build-standalone CPython
runtime.modifications: No binary modifications. Omit pip/site-packages, ensurepip, idlelib, stdlib test directory, scripts, include/libs, PDB, PYC and LIB/H files; add the 16 locked inference wheels. Retain Tcl/Tk and upstream notices.

external_cpp_prerequisite.name: Microsoft Visual C++ x64 v14 Redistributable
external_cpp_prerequisite.policy: Separate official prerequisite; no system DLL copying or installer redistribution. Install only when missing, under Microsoft's own terms.

download_policy: Explicit setup only; builder and application operate offline
ffmpeg_policy: Not redistributed. Use a separately installed Kdenlive toolchain. Exact build flags and hashes belong to private run identity, never a blanket LGPL assertion.
